integrity: Exact graph-coordinate proof with finite exact-arithmetic corroboration. The review is not an independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Requires every original edge to lie on a terminal geodesic and cap width no more than both the terminal distance and twice the minimum edge length.
Proves #P-hardness of exact volume differences under polynomial-time counting reductions, not #P-membership or approximation hardness.
Possible equivalent unindexed results remain a bibliographic risk.
title: Geodesic-poset volume law and a counting-complexity barrier for Lipschitz dual balls
